integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the published \(\ell_1(\Gamma)\) second-adjoint theorem by an explicit off-diagonal block embedding, followed by isometric conjugacy of \(T^*\). Domains, codomains, adjoint parity, zero and finite-index cases, and the sharpness example \(c\) were checked directly. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes that the dual spaces are linearly isometric, not merely isomorphic, to \(\ell_1\)-spaces. It establishes universal third-adjoint norm attainment and does not claim universal second-adjoint norm attainment for arbitrary \(\ell_1\)-preduals. Because the argument is a short consequence of a recent theorem, an equivalent observation may exist in incompletely indexed literature.
title: Third-adjoint norm attainment for all isometric \(\ell_1\)-predual pairs
